1981-2415-7452-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Cauldron of Essence and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron of Essence trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve Defiant Salvager's ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

3899-6553-8207.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Ferocity of the Hunt triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Ferocity of the Hunt from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

558-3629-8089.easyPrerequisites: Cloudsteel Kirin attached to a creature you control.
558-3629-8089.description:
Activate Carrion Howler by paying life.
Repeat step 1 until you have 0 life.
Cast Mister Negative by paying {5}{W}{B} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Mister Negative enters, it triggers, swapping your life total with an opponent's.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 life.

2104-2239-7370.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost.
Kykar triggers, exiling Ardent Elementalist.
Resolve Temporal Manipulation, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Kykar triggers, returning Ardent Elementalist from exile to the battlefield.
When Ardent Elementalist enters, it triggers, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

1765-2054-2440-7311.description:
Activate Improvised Arsenal by paying {4}{R}, creating a token copy of it.
Chishiro triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the creature token.
If needed, activate Urn of Godfire by paying {2}, adding {R}.
Repeat.
1765-2054-2440-7311.notes: The mana cost can be reduced if you control more creatures that share type(s) with the created tokens as the combo begins. You should perform step 4 only if you have no {R} in your mana pool. With infinite mana, the Improvised Arsenal tokens can be attached to creatures you control to make them infinitely large.

5231-5571-7310--6.description:
Use Kitsune to give Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Repeat from step 2.

Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost reduced by Hamza.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Airbending Lesson targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve Airbending Lesson, airbending Naru Meha.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha from exile by paying {0} due to Hamza.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

3698-6972-7158.description:
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Arcbound Slasher.
When Arcbound Slasher dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Slasher's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Slasher from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
When Arcbound Slasher enters, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

250-779-1315-1479-4288.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1315-1479-4288.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Sarinth Greatwurm and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Zuran Orb ability
Resolve the Sarinth Greatwurm trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Sarinth Greatwurm triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

856-2558-5256-6748.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
856-2558-5256-6748.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing Sword of the Meek, which is a Food due to Ragost, returning Cauldron Familiar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Cauldron Familiar enters, it and Sword of the Meek trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Sword of the Meek trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Repeat.

640-1894-5220-6900.description:
Activate Bile Urchin by sacrificing it.
When Bile Urchin dies, Mortuary and Dross Harvester trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Bile Urchin from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Dross Harvester trigger, causing you to gain 2 life
Resolve the Bile Urchin ability.
Cast Bile Urchin from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

888-3094-3649.notablePrerequisites: An opponent controls three nontoken creatures that they own and that are not commanders.
888-3094-3649.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Etrata, triggering its ability.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, targeting Etrata's trigger.
Holding priority, activate Tawnos by paying {U}{R} and tapping it, copying Lithoform Engine's trigger, targeting Etrata's trigger.
Resolve both Lithoform Engine triggers, copying Etrata's trigger twice.
Resolve all Etrata triggers, exiling three creatures an opponent controls and putting hit counters on them, and then causing that opponent to lose the game.

1661-5051-5078-6723.description:
Activate Traxos by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Traxos triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

2577-5670-5870.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
2577-5670-5870.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Gravecrawler, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
When Gravecrawler enters, Guide of Souls triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and get {E}.
Repeat.

3532-5078-5901-6768.notablePrerequisites:
Artist's Talent is at least level 2.
Uthros Research Craft has at least 12 charge counters on it.
3532-5078-5901-6768.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Diving Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a charge counter from Uthros Research Craft.
Uthros Research Craft triggers, putting a charge counter on it and causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

1115-1350-4010-6723.description:
Cast Farmer Cotton by paying at least {3}{G}{W}
When Farmer Cotton enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least three 1/1 Halfling creature tokens and three Food tokens.
Activate Farmer Cotton, three Halflings and three Foods by tapping them, adding {4}{G}{G}{W}.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {2}{W}, returning Farmer Cotton from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
1115-1350-4010-6723.notes: It is recommended to pay at least {1} additional to start to get infinite untapped tokens. This mana will be recuperated throughout the combo.

2292-6701--5.easyPrerequisites: One of the persist creatures does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
2292-6701--5.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing a persist creature without a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability and Szarel trigger.
Resolve the Szarel trigger, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the other persist creature.
Resolve the perist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

Activate Jade Mage by paying {2}{G}, creating three 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate the Saprolings by tapping them, adding {2}{G}.
Repeat.

Activate Trazyn using Nyx Lotus's ability by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Trazyn.
Repeat.

Soldevi Adnate does not have summoning sickness.
Nim Deathmantle attached to Village Bell-Ringer.
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {1}.

Activate any number of other creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {1}.
Activate Soldevi Adnate by tapping it and sacrificing Village Bell-Ringer, adding an amount of {B} equal to Village Bell-Ringer's mana value.

When Village Bell-Ringer enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping all creatures you control.
Repeat.

Cast Gemcutter Buccaneer by paying {3}{R}.
When Gemcutter Buccaneer enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a tapped 2/2 Cat or 3/1 Dog creature token due to Jinnie Fay.
When the Cat or Dog enters the battlefield as a Pirate due to Maskwood Nexus, Gemcutter Buccaneer triggers, creating a tapped 2/2 Cat or 3/1 Dog creature token due to Jinnie Fay.
Repeat step 3.

575-2034-3565.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one blue card in hand.
575-2034-3565.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Dragon's Eye Savants, adding {C}{C}.
When Dragon's Eye Savants dies, Yedora triggers, returning Dragon's Eye Savants to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Activate Dragon's Eye Savants by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Dragon's Eye Savants's morph ability by revealing a blue card from your hand, turning it face up.
Repeat.

Elemental Mastery attached to Galvanic Juggernaut.
Galvanic Juggernaut does not have summoning sickness.

When the Elemental dies, Galvanic Juggernaut triggers, untapping Galvanic Juggernaut.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability, putting a charge counter on it.
Repeat.

Curse of Death's Hold attached to you.

Cast Ruthless Ripper by paying {B}.

Activate Ruthless Ripper by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Ruthless Ripper's morph ability by revealing a black card from your hand, turning it face-up.
Ruthless Ripper triggers, causing target player to lose 2 life.
Repeat from step 2.

Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing an Angel.

The Spirit token becomes a 4/4 Spirit Angel due to having a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve Goblin Bombardment's ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the Spirit token.
Repeat from step 2.

When Vesperlark leaves the battlefield, it triggers, returning Felidar Guardian from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

Activate Words of Wind by paying {1}, causing each player to return a permanent from the battlefield to their hand whenever you would next draw a card this turn.

Repeat from step 3.
